modelName: My PHS — Conversational Flow / Data Entry Sequence

nodes.label:
Open
My Health Picture
nodes.note:
Person and CHW open My Health Picture together. May be first visit (no record) or a return visit (existing problems and frame history).

The session begins by reading where the person is — not by presenting everything at once.

nodes.label:
Activation
Band Check
nodes.note:
Quick PANAS check (10 adjectives, 1 minute) or use existing band if recent.

This is not a gate — it's a calibration. The full record is always one click away. The band only shapes what surfaces by default and how actions are worded.

nodes.label:
Band 1–2
One step at a time
"Ask your care team"
nodes.note:
Band 1-2: person has limited knowledge, skill, or confidence to act independently.

- Show only top 1-2 candidates
- Show top 3 gaps per section
- Frame plan options as: 'Things to ask your care team about'
- One question per exchange — don't stack
- 'Show full frame' toggle always available

nodes.label:
Band 3–4
Broader picture
"You can do this"
nodes.note:
Band 3-4: person has knowledge and confidence to self-manage and make decisions.

- Full frame visible
- All candidates shown
- Plan options framed as: 'Things you can do'
- Can handle multiple questions in one session
- Shared decision tools accessible directly

nodes.label:
Select problem
to work on today
nodes.note:
Prioritization uses two signals:

1. Attention Code (1-5) — clinical urgency of the top candidate for each problem
2. Activation Band — what the person can engage with today

Default: highest attention problem that matches the person's band. CHW can override.

At Band 1-2, one problem per session. At Band 3-4, may move between problems.

nodes.label:
Subjective
What you experience
nodes.note:
Questions only the person can answer:
- Symptoms, duration, character
- What makes it better or worse
- How it affects daily life
- Concerns and goals

The coupler frame provides specific prompts — not an open field. 'Does your knee hurt more going downstairs or on flat ground?' — not 'Tell me about your knee.'

This IS conversational support. The system generates the question; the CHW asks it in plain language.

nodes.label:
Objective
What we can measure
nodes.note:
Findings that can be gathered in the room right now:
- Blood pressure, pulse, weight
- Visual inspection, range of motion
- Device readings (glucometer, pulse ox)

Vs. findings that require scheduling:
- Lab work, imaging, specialist exam

The immediacy filter separates these two categories.

nodes.label:
Existing record
Confirm or correct
nodes.note:
Prior entries, FHIR data, and SCP imports already in the record.

Don't re-ask what's already known — surface it and ask for confirmation or correction. 'Your record shows you take levothyroxine — is that still correct?' saves time and signals that the record is being used.

This is also where conflicts from multiple sources surface for resolution.

nodes.label:
Immediately
actionable?
nodes.note:
For each gap or next step — can this be done right now, in this visit?

Three answers:
1. Yes — do it now (answer question, take measurement, document finding)
2. Needs scheduling — lab, imaging, referral
3. Needs escalation — Attention Code 1-2, beyond CHW scope

Immediacy shapes the session plan without overwhelming. Not everything has to happen today.

nodes.label:
Do now
Record finding
nodes.note:
Finding recorded into the appropriate slot in the coupler frame.

Every recorded finding immediately shifts probabilities in the Assessment — the picture updates in real time. The gap that was blank is now filled (or marked partial).

This is the payoff: one answer → visible change in the frame.

nodes.label:
Schedule
Lab / imaging / referral
nodes.note:
Gap acknowledged, action planned. The problem list shows 'pending: HbA1c ordered 2026-07-06' — the gap is no longer invisible.

Weed's insight applies here: the value isn't just filling the gap. It's making the gap visible and named, so it doesn't silently persist.

nodes.label:
Escalate
Attention Code 1–2
nodes.note:
Attention Code 1 ('Act now') or 2 ('Move fast') with a finding the CHW cannot act on alone.

Escalation is not failure — it is the system working correctly. The CHW has surfaced something important and named it. The physician receives a structured record with the gap already identified, not a vague concern.

See risks.html: CHW scope of practice boundary.

nodes.label:
Probabilities update
Gaps visible
Frame sharpens
nodes.note:
After each finding is recorded, the Assessment re-ranks candidates. The picture sharpens — or shifts.

This is the feedback loop Weed envisioned: the record teaches you what it doesn't know. Each answer makes the next question more precise.

The CHW can see: 'Before this visit, essential hypertension was at 52%. After recording CPAP adherence data, it moved to 47% and OSA-related HTN moved up.'

nodes.label:
Next best question
What moves the picture most?
nodes.note:
The system identifies which missing data point would most change the probability distribution.

Not just any gap — the gap with the highest information value. If TSH would resolve the 'levothyroxine over-replacement' candidate from 8% to near-zero or near-certain, TSH is the next best question.

This is decision support driving conversational support. The conversation is not random — it is guided by what matters most.

nodes.label:
Enough for today?
Session checkpoint
nodes.note:
Natural stopping points:
- Band 1-2: one problem addressed, one next step identified
- Band 3-4: frame reasonably complete for today, decisions discussed
- Attention escalation handled
- Person says they're done

A session does not need to complete a full frame. Partial progress is progress — and it is all preserved.

nodes.label:
My Current
Health Summary
+ SCP update
nodes.note:
Session ends with two outputs:

1. My Current Health Summary (Narrate) — plain-language paragraph: what is known, what is uncertain, what the open gaps mean, any shared decisions made. Readable by person, family, or any clinician picking up cold.

2. Update My Shared Care Plan — pushes the sharpened frame and decisions to the FedWiki page. The care team sees the record as it stands after today's session.
